title: git-vouch: ssh-rsa <-> did:key
description: Add ssh-rsa to SSH_KEY_FIELDS; RSA branch in ssh_to_did/did_to_ssh with minimal DER; size 2048-16384, odd e>=3; reject non-minimal mpint and DER (decode, re-encode, compare); raise MAX_DID_LEN from the 16384-bit maximum; fix the ed25519-else-P-256 branch.
acceptance_criteria: CCG rsa.json vectors (w3c-ccg/did-method-key 1b4f72d) map exactly both ways; ssh-keygen -e -m PEM DER agrees; 1024-bit, even e, non-minimal encodings rejected; real ssh-keygen -Y sign/verify with an RSA key passes
